request.prompt:
Create ORIGINAL production source prop atlas TF_BIBLE2_DISCOVERIES v1, for a side-view 2D pixel-art exploration game. Transparent RGBA 1536x1024 canvas, SIX complete isolated objects in precisely 3 columns by 2 rows, each cell512x512, every object has at least55px empty transparent margin in its cell. No text, no labels, no ground plane, no characters, no UI. Orthographic side elevation, no perspective floor. Crisp clean deliberate PIXEL ART, broad 3-5px clusters and sparse texture, stepped angular contours. Warm wood brown, deep pine green, subdued moss teal, tarnished bronze, pale gold upper-left daylight. Coherent ancient forest/mail/bell academy world, readable physical props with complete roots and feet, not glowing orbs.
Top-left cell: small HALF-BURIED BRONZE BELL PLATE, a curved etched bronze bell-shaped plaque on a joined moss root support, entire plate readable, tiny bronze loose clasp at base, about260px wide200px high.
Top-middle cell: ROOT HOLLOW CACHE, complete tiny tree hollow with a low mushroom-canopy roof and a small closed wood-and-bronze chest inside, roots form its base, one tiny pale green fungus lamp, about330px wide280px high. No large light halo.
Top-right cell: OLD NUMBERED BRIDGE BADGE, complete worn bronze octagonal plaque tied to short broken wooden bridge-end post with root feet, unreadable tiny engraving strokes, about220px wide280px high. No actual letters or numbers.
Bottom-left cell: SPIRAL HEARTWOOD CACHE, a physical wooden keepsake chest in a curled spiral root cradle, warm circular exposed wood heart inside open lid, feet all visible, about300px wide240px high.
Bottom-middle cell: OLD MAILBAG, a complete faded forest-green canvas mail satchel hanging from a low forked root stand with two visible root feet, bronze buckle, one small cream envelope half-visible, about250px wide280px high. No writing.
Bottom-right cell: BROKEN CROWN OBSERVATORY, a tiny ruined forest survey station: broken low bronze telescope aimed up-left, a rolled route chart on a low wood desk, mossy bark platform base with complete visible feet, about350px wide260px high. Keep recognizable silhouette, no glowing globe or huge building.
All six are independent correctly separated isolated props, intended to sit on existing REAL support surfaces at about50-90 world units wide in the game. Transparent outside each object, no painted shadow rectangle. Avoid blur, photorealism, painterly brushwork, noisy speckled leaves, vector art, gradient glows or decorative particles. No shared landscape between cells.

output_hint: Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-3f5f32f8-4422-4919-ae62-2902ce14d1ea.png by default. Copy original and leave original in place.
